mapper.select: select count(*) from media_assets where content_id = #{contentId} and kind = 'video'
mapper.update: update users set nickname = #{user.nickname}, avatar_url = #{user.avatarUrl}, bio = #{user.bio}, location = #{user.location}, source = 'crawler', source_user_id = #{user.sourceUserId} where id = #{user.id}
mapper.insert: insert into users ( id, nickname, avatar_url, bio, location, source, source_user_id ) values ( #{user.id}, #{user.nickname}, #{user.avatarUrl}, #{user.bio}, #{user.location}, 'crawler', #{user.sourceUserId} )
mapper.update: update content_items set type = #{content.type}, title = #{content.title}, description = #{content.description}, author_user_id = #{content.authorUserId}, cover_url = #{content.coverUrl}, source_url = #{content.sourceUrl}, status = 'published', visibility = 'public', publish_time = #{content.publishTime}, raw_json = #{content.rawJson} where id = #{content.id}
mapper.insert: insert into content_items ( id, type, title, description, author_user_id, cover_url, source_url, status, visibility, publish_time, raw_json ) values ( #{content.id}, #{content.type}, #{content.title}, #{content.description}, #{content.authorUserId}, #{content.coverUrl}, #{content.sourceUrl}, 'published', 'public', #{content.publishTime}, #{content.rawJson} )

insert into content_stats ( content_id, like_count, comment_count, favorite_count, share_count ) values ( #{stats.contentId}, #{stats.likeCount}, #{stats.commentCount}, #{stats.favoriteCount}, #{stats.shareCount} )
insert into content_tags (content_id, tag, sort_order) values (#{contentId}, #{tag}, #{sortOrder})
insert into content_recommend_words (content_id, word, sort_order) values (#{contentId}, #{word}, #{sortOrder})

insert into media_assets ( content_id, kind, url, storage_key, quality, sort_order, delivery_type, container_format ) values ( #{asset.contentId}, #{asset.kind}, #{asset.url}, #{asset.storageKey}, #{asset.quality}, #{asset.sortOrder}, #{asset.deliveryType}, #{asset.containerFormat} )
